missions.summary: Extracting 18 trapped civilians from residential areas near Bellandur Lake overflow zone.
missions.aiFindings: Lake overflow is fast-moving along Sarjapur Road. Highly recommend motorized rescue crafts and elevated access routes.
missions.riskAssessment: High risk of waterborne disease, structural debris collisions, and rapid water level rise.
recommendedResponsePlan: Deploy inflatable rescue boat to Bellandur overflow hot zone.
Secure anchor lines to elevated structures near Sarjapur Road.
Extract children and elderly first from low-lying apartments.
Establish secondary triage point at Brookefield Mall grounds.

timeline.event: Mission created via AI recommended response plan
BBMP Rescue Squad 3 dispatched to Bellandur location
Responders arrived on scene and launched inflatable rescue boat

missions.recommendedTeam: Civil Engineering Response Unit & Traffic Control
missions.summary: Road sinkhole on 80 Feet Road, BTM Layout, blocking major arterial route. 3 vehicles partially submerged.
missions.aiFindings: Sinkhole approximately 4m diameter. Likely caused by underground water main burst from recent flooding.
missions.riskAssessment: Risk of further collapse. Adjacent buildings may have compromised foundations.
recommendedResponsePlan: Immediately cordon off 100m radius around sinkhole.
Assess structural integrity of adjacent buildings.
Contact BWSSB to identify and shut off burst water main.

timeline.event: Sinkhole reported by citizen via app
BBMP Infrastructure Team dispatched from Jayanagar depot

broadcasts.title: Flash Flood Evacuation - Bellandur & Sarjapur Road
broadcasts.message: Severe lake overflow detected near Bellandur Lake. Residents of Sarjapur Road, Haralur Road, and Marathahalli Bridge vicinity must evacuate immediately to higher ground. Emergency shelter open at Brookefield Mall Ground Floor and BBMP Community Hall, Varthur.

broadcasts.title: Road Closure - BTM Layout 80 Feet Road Sinkhole
broadcasts.message: Major sinkhole detected on 80 Feet Road, BTM Layout 2nd Stage. Road closed between Silk Board Junction and BTM Bus Stop. Use Outer Ring Road or 100 Feet Road as alternate routes.

knowledgeDocuments.title: Swiftwater Evacuation Guidelines
knowledgeDocuments.content: During sudden floods, avoid walking or driving through water. Even 6 inches of moving water can knock you down, and 2 feet of water can sweep a vehicle away. If trapped in a building, move to the roof and signal for help.

knowledgeDocuments.title: Brush Fire Safety Distances
knowledgeDocuments.content: Ensure a defensible space of at least 30 feet around structures. If evacuating, close all windows, shut off gas main valves, and wear heavy, non-synthetic clothing to protect from embers.
